title: X-ray images of two alleged implants held by MUFON
description: Two side-by-side cropped images, one grayscale and one sepia-toned, each showing a small bright elongated object against a blurred background, presented as x-ray evidence of implants. The text states MUFON possesses copies of x-rays that may show implants, described as about the size of the tip of a pen and found in a 16-year-old female and a 76-year-old male from the northeast and southwestern U.S. The page is from a BAASS paper (page 3 of 5, Nov-08) discussing implant research payoff and an implant-removal plan of action.
